mapper.select: SELECT * FROM hr_offer WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{offerId} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_offer offer JOIN wf_process_instance instance ON instance.tenant_id = offer.tenant_id AND instance.instance_id = offer.process_instance_id AND instance.deleted = 0 WHERE offer.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND offer.id = #{offerId} AND offer.deleted = 0 AND instance.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND instance.status = #{status} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(instance.variables, '$.businessType')) = 'OFFER' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(instance.variables, '$.businessId')) = CAST(#{offerId} AS CHAR) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wf_task_history history WHERE history.tenant_id = instance.tenant_id AND history.instance_id = instance.instance_id AND history.operator_id = #{actor} AND history.operator_id <> instance.start_user_id AND ((history.action = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PASSED' THEN 'APPROVE' ELSE 'REJECT' END AND COALESCE(history.task_type, '') NOT LIKE 'AUTO_%') OR (history.action = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PASSED' THEN 'COUNTERSIGN_APPROVE' ELSE 'COUNTERSIGN_REJECT' END AND history.task_type IN ('OR_SIGN', 'COUNTERSIGN'))))
